recOverlayTabAudio.description: Recording control bar: chip shown when tab audio is enabled.

recOverlayWebcam.description: Recording control bar: chip shown when the webcam track is enabled.

recTitle.description: Popup: title of the record row when no session is pending.

recSub.description: Popup: subtitle of the record row.

recStop.description: Popup: label for the button that stops the active recording.

recCancel.description: Popup: label for the button that cancels the active recording.

recRecording.description: Popup: status label shown while a recording is in progress.

recPaused.description: Popup: status label shown while a recording is paused.

recStarting.description: Popup: shown in place of the elapsed time while the recording is still opening its streams, before the clock has a zero.

recMic.description: Popup: toggle chip for the microphone track.

recTabAudio.description: Popup: toggle chip for the tab audio track.

recWebcam.description: Popup: toggle chip for the webcam track.

recWebcamNoPreview.message: 내보내기에 추가돼요. 녹화 중에는 미리보기가 없어요.

recWebcamDenied.description: The permission frame's own denied-state text, and the control bar's screen-reader announcement when a requested camera is declined or unavailable (task 40: the frame itself is not visible, so the bar is what a sighted user reads).

recProtected.description: Popup: error toast shown when the active tab can't be recorded.

popupRecordRefused.message: 탭 녹화가 거부됐어요 — 녹화 설정 열기
popupRecordRefused.description: Popup button shown after the user refuses the inline tabCapture prompt.

recFailStartUnreachable.message: 녹화를 시작하지 못했어요. 확장 프로그램이 응답하지 않아요. 다시 시도하세요.
recFailStartUnreachable.description: Popup: error toast when REC_START never reached the service worker.

recFailStartBlocked.message: 녹화를 시작하지 못했어요. 이 페이지는 녹화할 수 없어요. 일반 탭으로 전환한 뒤 다시 시도하세요.
recFailStartBlocked.description: Popup: error toast when the start found no recordable tab (gone, or a protected URL).

recFailStartBusy.message: 이미 녹화가 진행 중이에요. 새 녹화를 시작하기 전에 먼저 중지하세요.
recFailStartBusy.description: Popup: error toast when a start arrives while a recording is live.

recFailStartFailed.message: 녹화를 시작하지 못했어요. 탭을 준비할 수 없었어요. 탭을 새로고침한 뒤 다시 시도하세요.
recFailStartFailed.description: Popup: error toast when the worker's start threw before the engine was asked to capture.

recFailCleanup.message: 실패한 녹화가 아직 저장되어 있어요. 레코더 페이지에서 삭제하세요.
recFailCleanup.description: Popup: error toast when a failed session could not be tidied up.

recFailEngine.message: 녹화가 시작되기 전에 중지됐어요. 탭을 캡처할 수 없었어요. 다시 시도하세요.
recFailEngine.description: Popup: error toast when the offscreen engine failed to open its streams.

recFailEngineUnreachable.message: 아무것도 녹화되고 있지 않아요. 레코더가 시작되지 않았어요. 중지한 뒤 다시 시도하세요.
recFailEngineUnreachable.description: Popup: error toast when OFFSCREEN_START never reached the offscreen engine, so the badge and control bar claim a recording that is not happening.

recFailEngineStalled.message: 녹화가 시작되지 않았고, 중지 요청에도 응답이 없었어요. 저장된 내용은 없어요. 다시 시도하세요.
recFailEngineStalled.description: Popup: the user pressed Stop on a recording that had not begun, and the offscreen recorder never answered. The run was torn down.

popupOpenFailed.message: 페이지를 열 수 없었어요. 다시 시도하세요.
popupOpenFailed.description: Popup: error toast when chrome.tabs.create fails for the setup page, the editor or the recorder.

recFailChunkWrite.message: 이 녹화의 일부가 저장되지 않고 있어요. 녹화를 중지하고 레코더 페이지에서 저장된 내용을 확인하세요.
recFailChunkWrite.description: Popup: error toast when a chunk write to IndexedDB failed mid-recording, so the file is shorter than the clock says.

recFailEventsWrite.message: 커서 트랙이 저장되지 않고 있어요. 영상은 괜찮지만 줌과 클릭 효과는 빠져요.
recFailEventsWrite.description: Popup: error toast when cursor-event writes to IndexedDB failed mid-recording, leaving the video intact.

recOverlayStarting.description: Recording control bar: shown in place of the timer while the recording is still opening its streams. Keep it short; it replaces a 0:00 clock.

recOverlayNotSaving.description: Recording control bar: warning chip shown when chunks are failing to reach storage. Keep it short; it sits in a row of three-letter track chips.

recOverlayCamDenied.description: Recording control bar: warning chip shown when a requested camera was declined or unavailable. Keep it short; it sits in a row of three-letter track chips.

recFailRecorderOpen.message: 녹화는 저장됐지만 레코더 페이지가 열리지 않았어요. 아래의 ‘최근 녹화 복구’를 사용하세요.
recFailRecorderOpen.description: Popup: error toast when chrome.tabs.create for the recorder page failed after a recording finished.

recFailQuery.message: 녹화 상태를 확인할 수 없어요. 레코더 페이지를 열어 확인하세요.
recFailQuery.description: Popup: error toast when REC_QUERY threw, so "not recording" cannot be trusted.

recFailOverlayBlocked.message: 이 페이지에서는 녹화 컨트롤을 열 수 없었어요. 여기에서 녹화를 중지하세요.
recFailOverlayBlocked.description: Popup: error toast when the in-page control bar could not be injected.

recFailOverlayLost.message: 이 페이지에서 녹화 컨트롤이 사라졌어요. 여기에서 녹화를 중지하세요.
recFailOverlayLost.description: Popup: error toast when the in-page control bar stopped reporting mid-recording.

recFailControlUnreachable.message: 요청이 레코더에 전달되지 않았어요. 확장 프로그램이 응답하지 않아요. 다시 시도하세요.
recFailControlUnreachable.description: Popup: error toast when stop/cancel never reached the service worker.

recFailSessionLoad.message: 녹화를 열 수 없었어요. 불완전한 녹화일 수 있어요.
recFailSessionLoad.description: Recorder page: error toast when a session could not be read out of IndexedDB.

recFailSegmentSkipped.message: 이 녹화의 일부가 재생되지 않아 내보내기에서 제외됐어요.
recFailSegmentSkipped.description: Recorder page: error toast when one or more segments were skipped during an export.

recFailExport.message: 내보내기에 실패했어요. 저장된 파일은 없어요. 다시 시도하세요.
recFailExport.description: Recorder page: error toast when the export threw.

recFailSaveInterrupted.description: Recorder page: error toast when the Save dialog's download was interrupted for a reason other than the user cancelling it.

recFailSaveUnverified.message: 저장이 완료됐는지 확인할 수 없어요. 녹화는 그대로 보관돼요.
recFailSaveUnverified.description: Recorder page: error toast when the download never reported a terminal state within the bounded wait.

recorderSaveCancelled.description: Recorder page: toast shown when the user dismisses the export's Save dialog.

recorderFailed.description: Recorder page: pill on a session whose recording never started.

recRecover.description: Popup: link that reopens the editor for a crashed/unfinished recording session.

recContinue.description: Popup: record row title when a continue-session is pending from the editor. Also the recorder page header button that starts a continue-session.

recAcrossSites.description: Settings: label for the row that grants recording access to all sites.

recAcrossSitesHint.message: 탭이 다른 사이트로 이동해도 커서 오버레이가 유지돼요. 모든 사이트에 대한 접근 권한을 부여해요.

recorderExport.description: Recorder page: button that renders the edited recording to a WebM file.

recorderCancelConfirm.description: Recorder page: armed state of the export Cancel button, click again to confirm.

recorderExportRemaining.description: Recorder page: wall-clock time left in an export in progress, formatted m:ss (or h:mm:ss for a long recording).

recorderExportStayVisible.message: 이 탭을 화면에 계속 표시하세요. 탭이 숨겨지면 렌더링이 멈춰요.

setupAcrossSites.description: Setup page: row title for the all-urls host permission.

setupAcrossSitesDesc.description: Setup page: row description for the all-urls host permission.

popupSetupLink.description: Popup settings: row that opens the recording setup page.

editorAnnotationCountOther.description: Editor live region: several annotations, e.g. "3 annotations".

editorCutCountOther.description: Editor draft-restore pill: several cuts, e.g. "3 cuts".

editorNoAnnotations.description: Editor live region: fragment used mid-sentence when a delete leaves nothing selected, e.g. "Rectangle deleted, no annotations left."

editorAnnotationFallback.description: Editor live region: generic name for an annotation type the tool list has no label for (should not normally happen).

editorAnnounceSelect.description: Editor live region: one annotation was selected.

editorAnnounceSelectMany.description: Editor live region: several annotations were selected, e.g. "2 of 3 annotations selected."

editorAnnounceDeselect.description: Editor live region: the selection was cleared.

editorAnnounceAdd.description: Editor live region: a new annotation was drawn.

editorAnnounceMove.description: Editor live region: one annotation was moved.

editorAnnounceMoveMany.description: Editor live region: several annotations were moved, e.g. "3 annotations moved."

editorAnnounceResize.description: Editor live region: one annotation was resized.

editorAnnounceResizeMany.description: Editor live region: several annotations were resized, e.g. "3 annotations resized."

editorAnnounceDelete.description: Editor live region: one annotation was deleted.

editorAnnounceDeleteMany.description: Editor live region: several annotations were deleted.

editorAnnounceDuplicate.description: Editor live region: the selection was duplicated, e.g. "2 annotations duplicated."

editorAnnounceRedo.description: Editor live region: a redo step ran. Followed in code by an optional picture-size sentence and the current layer count.

editorStepImageHeight.description: Editor live region: the picture changed height on an undo/redo step that put back or took a cut.

editorHandleTop.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the top edge.

editorHandleTopRight.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the top-right corner.

editorHandleRight.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the right edge.

editorHandleBottomRight.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the bottom-right corner.

editorHandleBottom.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the bottom edge.

editorHandleBottomLeft.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the bottom-left corner.

editorHandleLeft.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the left edge.

editorHandleStart.description: Editor live region: the cut band's start handle.

editorHandleEnd.description: Editor live region: the cut band's end handle.

editorCropPhrase.description: Editor live region: the size and place of the crop rectangle.

editorAnnounceCropHandle.description: Editor live region: a crop handle is now active, followed by the crop's size and place.

editorAnnounceCropApplied.description: Editor live region: the crop was applied.

editorCanvasKeyboardHelp.message: 오른쪽 대괄호를 누르면 다음 주석을, 왼쪽 대괄호를 누르면 이전 주석을 선택해요. 대괄호와 함께 Shift를 누르면 선택을 바꾸는 대신 그 주석을 선택에 추가해요. Enter를 누르면 툴바에서 고른 도구를 놓아요. 화살표 키로 선택 항목을 1픽셀씩 옮기고, Shift와 화살표로 10픽셀씩 옮기고, Alt와 화살표로 크기를 조정해요. Alt와 D를 누르면 선택 항목을 복제해요. 자르기가 열려 있으면 화살표 키로 옮기고, 대괄호로 여덟 개의 핸들 중 하나를 고르고, Alt와 화살표로 그 핸들에서 크기를 조정하고, Enter로 적용하고 Escape로 취소해요. Cut 도구에서는 Enter로 이미지를 가로지르는 구간을 시작하고, 위아래 화살표로 옮기고, Alt와 화살표로 크기를 조정하고, Enter로 잘라내고 Escape로 취소해요. Cut 도구에서 Delete를 누르면 가장 가까운 잘라낸 구간을 되돌려요.
